fields.title: Bolpatra tender record
fields.description: One record per row/tender. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_LIST (mode=list, one row from the listing table) or TENDER_DETAIL (mode=detail, a raw label/value passthrough of the tender's own detail page -- field set can vary slightly by procurement type, so extra fields beyond those listed below may appear). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a query/tender fails or is not found.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'latest' or a 'search:...' summary of the filters used. For detail records: the tenderId or URL that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-listing or S1-detail on success, 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (not_found, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: TENDER_LIST only -- total tenders bolpatra reports matching this query across its whole history (200,000+ for 'latest'/unfiltered), before this actor's maxResults truncation.

_totalReturned.title: Total returned by this query
_totalReturned.description: TENDER_LIST only -- how many rows bolpatra actually returned for this one query (10-30 depending on which filters were set -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md), before maxResults truncation.

tenderUrl.title: Tender detail URL
tenderUrl.description: Link to this tender's full detail page (this actor's own canonical URL form for mode=detail input, not necessarily how bolpatra's own UI links to it).

ifbNo.title: IFB/RFP/EOI/PQ No.
ifbNo.description: TENDER_LIST only -- the procuring entity's own tender reference number.

publicEntityName.title: Public entity name
publicEntityName.description: The government office/entity running this procurement.

procurementType.title: Procurement type
procurementType.description: TENDER_LIST only -- raw text combining category and method, e.g. 'Works NCB'.

status.title: Status
status.description: TENDER_LIST only -- often blank for a normally open tender; populated for amended/cancelled ones.

noticePublishedDate.title: Notice published date
noticePublishedDate.description: TENDER_LIST only. Nepali government date/time as shown by bolpatra (dd-mm-yyyy HH:MM).

daysLeft.title: Days left
daysLeft.description: TENDER_LIST only -- raw text as shown by bolpatra, e.g. '20 days'.

procurementCategory.title: Procurement category
procurementCategory.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. Goods, Works, Consultancy.

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. NCB, ICB, Sealed Quotation.

biddingProcedure.title: Bidding procedure
biddingProcedure.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- e.g. 'Pre Qualification Not Needed'.

bankName.title: Bank name
bankName.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- where the bid document fee is paid.

contactOfTheOfficialInvitingBid.title: Contact of the official inviting bid

bidDocument.title: Bid documents
bidDocument.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- list of {documentType, date, downloadUrl}.

addendum.title: Addenda
addendum.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- list of {documentType, date, downloadUrl}, usually empty.

bidQueryResponse.title: Bid query responses
bidQueryResponse.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- list of {documentType, date, downloadUrl}, usually empty.

loi.title: Letter of Intent (LOI)
loi.description: TENDER_DETAIL only -- list of {documentType, date, downloadUrl}, usually empty until a winner is decided.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
